One change per request:
goal · add task · edit task · remove task

g.text: Call 1: edits in place; remove deletes the line

text.tspan: Call 3: goal refused; a task with an artifact refused;
edit keeps originalText (first wording, once);
add stamps addedAt; remove sets cut (stays, struck through);
the first change stamps revisedAt
